source: HPE press release: Mzansi Mind advances South Africa's sovereign AI ambitions (10-22-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Customer Mzansi Mind: Mzansi Mind, a South African sovereign enterprise AI platform from Solcon Capital, selected HPE ProLiant Compute DL380a Gen12 servers with NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs and HPE Juniper Networking QFX5120 switches to power its Siya language model and agentic AI framework; the infrastructure is hosted at Equinix's Johannesburg colocation data center and supplied through HPE Platinum partner Datacentrix, with HPE Tech Care support. No deal size or unit count is stated.
